title: BiMa-ECGSR: reconstructing the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with bidirectional state-space models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23345v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wearables and monitors record few electrocardiogram (ECG) leads; most diagnostic tools assume 12 leads. BiMa-ECGSR reconstructs the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with a bidirectional Mamba state-space encoder--decoder, as regression (BiMa-SR) or diffusion (DiBiMa-SR). Models were trained on PTB-XL for six input sets (I; II; I+II; I+II+V1; I+II+V2; I+II+V1+V4), see only the measured leads at inference, and were tested on the PTB-XL test fold (2,198 records) and two external cohorts (Georgia, 10,275 records; Chapman-Shaoxing/Ningbo, 43,559). From lead II alone, the pooled median Pearson correlation (PCC) over the 11 predicted leads was 0.914 on PTB-XL, against 0.784 for a least-squares linear filter (lead I: 0.906 against 0.789). As limb leads are exactly derivable from I and II, multi-lead inputs were compared on predicted chest leads: 0.939 against 0.849 for I+II and 0.979 against 0.962 for I+II+V1+V4. translated_title: BiMa-ECGSR：利用双向状态空间模型从缩减导联集重构12导联心电图
translated_abstract: 可穿戴设备和监测仪仅能记录少量心电图（ECG）导联，而大多数诊断工具都假设使用12导联。BiMa-ECGSR通过双向Mamba状态空间编码器-解码器，以回归（BiMa-SR）或扩散（DiBiMa-SR）两种方式从缩减的导联集重构12导联心电图。模型在PTB-XL数据集上针对六种输入导联组合（I；II；I+II；I+II+V1；I+II+V2；I+II+V1+V4）进行训练，推理时仅使用实际测量的导联，并在PTB-XL测试集（2,198条记录）以及两个外部队列（Georgia，10,275条记录；Chapman-Shaoxing/Ningbo，43,559条记录）上进行了评估。仅使用II导联时，在PTB-XL上11个预测导联的合并中位皮尔逊相关系数（PCC）达到0.914，而最小二乘线性滤波器仅为0.784（I导联：0.906对0.789）。由于肢体导联可由I和II导联精确推导，多导联输入的比较在预测的胸前导联上进行：I+II组合为0.939对0.849，I+II+V1+V4组合为0.979对0.962。BiMa-SR超越了线性方法。
tldr: BiMa-ECGSR提出了一种基于双向Mamba状态空间模型的编码器-解码器架构，能够从单导联或少量导联高精度地重构完整的12导联心电图，并在多个大规模内外部数据集上显著优于传统线性重构方法。
en_tdlr: BiMa-ECGSR introduces a bidirectional Mamba state-space encoder-decoder that accurately reconstructs the full 12-lead ECG from single or reduced lead sets, substantially outperforming linear reconstruction methods across multiple large-scale internal and external datasets.
